what: Pressing the hamburger button instantly raises a color panel covering the screen, and big pill links burst out from −10°, .8× and transparent to their own set tilts over .45s power3.out at .08s intervals. Small pills come .25s earlier at −8° with .06s intervals, and the lower group (social) appears another .25s earlier. The panel background changes to the next color each time it opens (continuing within the session), and hovering one pill pushes the others back to .3. On narrow screens, there’s no tilt: items rise from 20px below at .07s intervals with power2.out. The two-line button folds into an X (.3s)

options.overlap: Seconds to advance the next batch, default .25
options.tones: Number of background colors to cycle, default 4 — colors are --fx-tone-0…3
options.wide: Minimum width (px) for using the tilt-and-burst type, default 1025
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Open/close button (required) — the two inner spans fold into an X
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Cover panel (required) — click anywhere on the background to close
options.[data-fx-part=pill]·[data-fx-part=sub]·[: Big pill · small pill · last group — data-key holds the tilt (degrees)
options.--fx-tone-0…3·--fx-line-w·--fx-line-h·--: Panel background colors, button row width·thickness·gap (default 60·6·8px)
options.--fx-line-a·--fx-line-b: Distance the top and bottom lines move when turning into an X — default is even around the middle of the two lines, the reference original uses 9px and −5px

use: Menu 1…
note: In the original the panel disappears immediately on close, so the pill retract is not visible — kept as is. The X default is evenly centered across two lines, to offset them like the original, top 9px · bottom −5px, use --fx-line-a · --fx-line-b. Esc closes it, and on open focus goes to the first link.

from.where: shared.js bubble menu (original .bubble-menu-overlay · .pill-link · .sub-pill, backgrounds in turn of 4 colors #EA642F · #69B7C9 · #CAEF41 · #BDE8EF)
